rules: Liveness must describe process health, not upstream health.
Readiness must fail when required local dependencies are unavailable.
Retries must be bounded and use backoff with jitter.
Circuit breakers must permit at most one half-open probe at a time.
Request timeouts must remain effective when callers supply an AbortSignal.
Successful requests must emit successful telemetry even if earlier retry attempts failed.
Rejected messages must be durably quarantined rather than silently discarded.
Shutdown must stop accepting new work before terminating active work.
Rate limits must fail closed at the request boundary and emit Retry-After.
File-backed persistence must use atomic replacement to prevent torn writes.
